title: Activity Launcher
subtitle: Generic sample activities for testing launcher rendering.
description: Choose an activity, inspect its sample prompt, and test the copy-to-clipboard behavior.
instructions: Choose one of the sample activities below.
Review its description and optional guidance.
Preview or copy the generated prompt.
Use the copied text wherever you want to test it.

activities.title: Brainstorm Names
activities.description: Generate possible names for an imaginary product or project.
activities.tip: Adding a target audience or desired tone usually produces more focused suggestions.
activities.prompt: Help me brainstorm ten names for an imaginary reusable water bottle designed for hikers. Give each name a one-sentence explanation.

activities.title: Organize Notes
activities.description: Turn a fictional collection of rough notes into a clean outline.
activities.tip: The prompt deliberately asks the assistant not to invent missing information.
activities.prompt: Organize the following fictional notes into a concise outline. Preserve the original meaning and clearly mark anything that is ambiguous instead of filling in missing details.

activities.title: Compare Options
activities.description: Ask an assistant to compare several imaginary choices using explicit criteria.
activities.prompt: Compare three fictional commuter bicycles using purchase price, weight, maintenance requirements, comfort, and suitability for a five-mile city commute. Present the result in a compact table.
